title: Bringing Tom DeLonge and Lue Elizondo to the Zanesville metal
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Bringing Tom DeLonge and Lue Elizondo to the Zanesville metal, about c. 2017 at Zanesville, Ohio, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I took Tom Dong and Lou Alzando to Zanesville or to to Pennsylvania or Ohio.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs appear around him and that NASA scientists have studied him, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that around 2017 he took a rock musician, Tom DeLonge, and a former Pentagon official, Lue Elizondo, to see a piece of metal in Zanesville, Ohio, though he is unsure whether it was Ohio or Pennsylvania. The story ties the metal to a crashed craft, and he also mentions the names Hal Puthoff and Timothy Taylor. If true, it would mean well-known figures in the UFO world went to examine possible crash material in person.
